posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
The Script Call List (the one Aqua linked) focuses on various "useful" script call examples. Perhaps you'd prefer something more like this?
https://kinoar.github.io/rmmv-doc-web/index.html
(Personally I just search stuff up in the core script files.)

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: RPG Maker doesn't have much in the way of official documentation outside of the tutorial that walks you through events and hovering over things in the menus. As far as scripts go you're just expected to look at the core files to see how things are defined and coded.
